verdict.rationale: Moss repeatedly states a concrete latency figure (sub-10 ms search) across its homepage, llms.txt, and integration docs, and the homepage offers a 'Run a Latency Test' feature that lets users measure latency themselves. However, the pack has no published benchmark report, methodology, dataset or hardware details, percentile breakdowns, or independent measurements, and no recall numbers at all. missing for 10: published benchmark methodology and results, recall/accuracy metrics, independent or third-party latency corroboration, documented test conditions (dataset size, hardware, p50/p99).
